bio.text: Justin Olson, a Republican, has represented District 10 in the Arizona House of Representatives since January 13, 2025, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He previously served in the Arizona House from 2011 to 2017 and on the Arizona Corporation Commission from 2017 to 2023, after Gov. Doug Ducey appointed him on October 17, 2017.
Olson earned a B.S. from Arizona State University and worked as a congressional aide to Rep. Trent Franks and as a senior research analyst for the Arizona Tax Research Association.
